crossRefs.note: The priest shall examine the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean. It is leprosy.

translations.web: The priest shall examine the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean. It is leprosy.
translations.bsb: When the priest sees the raw flesh, he must pronounce him unclean. The raw flesh is unclean; it is a skin disease.
translations.kjv: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: for the raw flesh is unclean: it is a leprosy.
translations.asv: And the priest shall look on the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean: it is leprosy.
